dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a sharp point at the visible frame edge.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Presence of a slight asymmetrical lateral bulge on the left margin (image perspective) at the mid-body section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Medium frequency mottling; darker grey pixel clusters are concentrated around the blowhole and cranial region, with isolated lighter circular patches on the mid-left dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the darker pigmented cranial area and the lighter mid-dorsal baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct light-colored circular blotches on the mid-left dorsal plane and faint, thin linear marks on the lower third of the visible dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple light-toned circular depigmentation marks on the left mid-body dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced circular blowhole orifice clearly visible at the anterior end of the dorsal plane.
